_comment: Maps corpus lane labels to detector lane ids. Lane naming is NOT hardcoded
in score_detector.py, so later user-named spectral regions score without
code changes: repoint `lanes` at whatever ids the detector emits.
analysis_latency_ms is the MEASURED constant delay between a ground-truth
onset and the hop the detector reports it on. It is a property of the
analysis front end (2048-point FFT filling at hop 256), not of the
detector, and it is declared here rather than hidden inside the scorer.
Scores are reported BOTH raw and latency-compensated so the compensation
can never quietly manufacture a better number.
